mcp__scrapling__make_request.why: it is a raw HTTP client that reaches no address guard and no source ledger, so it can fetch any address unrecorded
mcp__scrapling__make_request.instead: use browser_fetch_once for one page, or browser_open then browser_fetch for several pages from one site, ending with close_session. Carry on with the task; do not stop on this denial
